verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a Public API in depth. It offers personal `pk_` tokens and OAuth2 auth, an interactive in-browser "Try It" panel, and per-version OpenAPI specs. Endpoints cover tasks, attachments, custom fields, task types, filtering, views and comments, and an llms.txt (HTTP 200) makes the docs agent-friendly. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show the spec isn't at the standard well-known paths, which does not contradict the documented spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and the OpenAPI spec is not discoverable at conventional paths.
